evidence_summary: Existing repository PQ, mentor, transformation, and reward-tier research was revalidated. Acquisition endpoints and classifications were retained, while unresolved probabilities and unsupported numerical mechanics were not invented.
evidence_limits: Thunder Flash and Total Detonation Ball retain documented Basic/First-Clear reward semantics rather than an inferred Ultimate Finish gate.
Hit/Bojack/Tien mentor endpoints are verified without fabricating frame, damage, or stamina values.
Turn Golden retains Frieza Race CaC scope and documented 300-Ki transformation mechanics.
